name: Globle 🌎
desc:
🌍✈️ Welcome to GLOBLE, where you test your knowledge of the world by finding the hidden Mystery Country!

Guess the hidden country in as few tries as possible, guided by "Hot and Cold" color clues: the deeper the red, the closer your guess is to the target. Explore the map and see if you can pin down the location before your friends! 🧠

👍 Support the Creators! If you enjoy the game, please consider giving a thumbs up and a favourite—it helps us a lot and keeps the updates coming!

Based off Globle (We are not affiliated with the real game.)
